move: ring draws around, checkmark strokes itself, disc pops in behind, pulse rings out
how: A green ring circle, a green disc (scale 0), a green tick path and a white tick path over it, a thin pulse circle, and a message line clipped in a 56px-high box. 0-27%: the ring draws with drawSVG 0->100% from -90deg (power3.inOut); at 17% the green tick draws itself (power3.out, 0.55s). At 35% the disc scales 0->1 with back.out(1.8), the white tick redraws over it and the pulse ring scales 1->1.45 while fading (power2.out); the whole badge does a 1.06 yoyo bump. At 43% 'Payment complete' slides up from yPercent 120 (expo.out). Exit at 83%: text slides up out (power3.in), badge scales to 0 with back.in(1.8), so the frame ends empty; the ring stays drawn under the disc.
adapt: Change the message string, the green (#22c55e) for the brand success colour, the tick path for another icon, and the background. Keep the 0.8s ring draw, the back.out(1.8) disc pop and the 0.25 yoyo bump.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the badge SVG and the .msg span inside el; animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline with each position expressed as a fraction of D (ring 0-0.27D, disc at 0.35D, text at 0.43D, exit at 0.83D). Selectors must be scoped to el; needs DrawSVGPlugin registered; the .from() on .msg span needs immediateRender:false if built inside a paused parent.
caveats: from() tween on .msg span; use immediateRender:false when composing into a larger timeline
frame ends empty (ring remains but under a scale-0 disc, effectively invisible) rather than returning to the drawn state
